title: tests/integration prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig: insertPromotionReviewsRow omits NOT NULL requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan (latent sqlstate 23502; same class as ISS-0708/GH-793 Cluster A)

incidental_of.trigger: WF03-GH793 step-1 diagnosis (ISSUE-FIXER) — latent duplicate of the ISS-0708/GH-793 Cluster A fixture defect spotted in the sibling PRM-08 test file while diagnosing PRM-06/07
incidental_of.context: PRM-08 integration-test fixture defect. NOT a PRM-06/07 defect and NOT covered by ISS-0708/GH-793 scope; explicitly out of scope there. Filed per No-Issue-Left-Local-Only / ISSUE_QUEUE.md as a claimable loop item.

scope: Test-fixture defect in tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig only. The insertPromotionReviewsRow helper INSERT omits the NOT NULL columns (requested_by, def_type, serialised_plan) that migrations/096_promotion_reviews.sql added to promotion_reviews, so the INSERT violates the NOT NULL constraint and fails with sqlstate 23502 whenever it runs against the current migration set. No production code and no migration is implicated.
affected_areas: migrations/096_promotion_reviews.sql (promotion_reviews requested_by / def_type / serialised_plan NOT NULL columns)
description: Identical defect class to ISS-0708/GH-793 Cluster A, located in the PRM-08 integration test file: the helper `insertPromotionReviewsRow` (tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig lines 233-258) INSERTs only (id, tenant_id, status, def_id, plan_digest, created_at) into promotion_reviews. Migration 096 defines requested_by uuid NOT NULL, def_type text NOT NULL and serialised_plan text NOT NULL on that table, so the fixture INSERT will fail with sqlstate 23502 (not-null violation) whenever PRM-08 tests that seed a promotion_reviews row run against the current migration set. Latent today because the promotion_reviews table is created by the PRM-04 batch and PRM-08 AC4 (superseded_review_id) is conditional on the table existing; the defect is exposed as soon as the row-seeding path executes. Out of scope for ISS-0708/GH-793 (PRM-06/07 scope). This ADHOC step-0.5 only files and registers the defect; no fix is implemented (becomes a claimable loop item for its own WF-03 cycle).
symptom: Latent sqlstate 23502 (not-null violation) on promotion_reviews.requested_by / def_type / serialised_plan when the insertPromotionReviewsRow fixture helper in tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig runs its INSERT against the current migration set. Identical failure to the pre-fix TC-PRM-06-03 in ISS-0708/GH-793.
root_cause: Test fixture pre-dates the schema migration: migrations/096_promotion_reviews.sql added requested_by, def_type and serialised_plan as NOT NULL columns to promotion_reviews, but the prm-08 test helper insertPromotionReviewsRow was never updated to supply them. The same root-cause class as ISS-0708/GH-793 Cluster A (which fixed the identical helper in tests/integration/prm-06-07-promotion-assertion.test.zig), left latent in the sibling prm-08 file.
investigation_notes: Confirmed 2026-08-16: (1) WF03-GH793-20260816 step-1 inner report records the finding — 'Same insertPromotionReviewsRow defect exists in tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig (lines 233-258): omits requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan -> latent sqlstate 23502. Out of scope for ISS-0708 (PRM-06/07 scope); recommend separate tracking.' (2) Read tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig lines 233-258 — the INSERT lists only (id, tenant_id, status, def_id, plan_digest, created_at); requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan are absent. (3) Read migrations/096_promotion_reviews.sql — requested_by uuid NOT NULL, def_type text NOT NULL, serialised_plan text NOT NULL confirmed. (4) fn:search-issues over docs/issues/ + gh issue list --search 'prm-08' / 'insertPromotionReviewsRow' / 'ISS-0711' --state all: no existing ISS or GitHub issue covers the prm-08 fixture defect (ISS-0708/GH-793 covers PRM-06/07 only; ISS-0702 references only the prm08 build target wiring). New issue. (5) Registry next_issue_id 711; docs/issues/ISS-0711.json does not exist — no local or GitHub collision.
reproduction: Not executed in this ADHOC (file-only, no fix). Expected reproduction: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm08 with a promotion_reviews row-seeding path (PRM-08 AC4) executing -> sqlstate 23502 on requested_by (or def_type/serialised_plan). Exact same failure observed pre-fix for TC-PRM-06-03 in ISS-0708/GH-793.
fix_diff: Add requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan to the fixture INSERT, mirroring the ISS-0708/GH-793 Cluster A fix: add a requested_by parameter to insertPromotionReviewsRow, pass a fresh random UUID at the call site, and include requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan columns in the INSERT column list / VALUES. Call sites: TC-PRM-08-04 (superseded_review_id path) seeds a promotion_reviews row; update every call site to supply the new argument. No production code or migration change.

All call sites updated to pass the new requested_by argument
No production code or migration files changed

actions: Integration-test fixtures must be kept in sync with schema migrations that add NOT NULL / FK columns: when a migration adds a NOT NULL column to a table the tests seed, the corresponding test helper INSERT must include the new column in the same change, and the suite must be run against the migration set that introduces the constraint.

When a test-helper fixture defect is found and fixed in one test file, grep sibling test files for the same helper/INSERT pattern and fix or file them too (this defect is the prm-08 duplicate of the ISS-0708/GH-793 prm-06-07 fix).
PRM-08 integration tests that seed promotion_reviews rows should reuse the fixed helper (single source of truth) rather than duplicating the INSERT inline.
